_meta.warning: ETA, Bay, and the RETURNING/ARRIVED/FIELD badge are FRONTEND-FABRICATED demo values (not seeded, not backend). See _frontendFabricated block.

truckCard._source: getReturnPreVisibilityTrucks(warehouseId) -> TruckSummaryDTO (best non-terminal Delivery per operational Motorized Vehicle whose Vehicle.Fulfillment_Location = warehouse)
truckCard.truckLocationId: <Delivery__c.Truck_Location__c — the inventory Location on the truck>
truckCard.deliveryStatus: <Delivery__c.Status__c — real value is Out For Delivery or Delivered; RETURNING badge is NOT this>

kpiStrip._note: Card totals re-derived in JS as cases = sum(rawUnits/UPC) from the load summary cache; totalQuantityOnHand/sellableQuantity/unsellableQuantity on the DTO are RAW UNITS.

loadSummary._backingData: Inventory__c + Lot_Inventory__c on Truck_Location__c (audit note 2026-07-19 §5b: 'lot cargo aboard'). isSellable = Lot__r.Is_Sellable__c. reasonCode from Inventory_Adjustment__c via Reason_Code__mdt.
loadSummary._display: STATUS column 'Restockable' = LoadLineDTO.isSellable=true; QTY 'Cases: N' = quantityOnHand(raw units)/unitsPerCase.

_frontendFabricated._warning: These appear on the card but have NO backing record. Do NOT try to seed them.

eta.source: HARDCODED_ETAS[index % 7]; TRUCK#766 is card index 0 -> '2:14 PM'

bay.source: bay = `bay${(index % 4) + 1}`; index 0 -> bay1 -> 'Bay 1'. Operator-overridable dropdown only.

statusBadge.source: _demoReturningTruckId — one in-field truck picked at RANDOM per page load as RETURNING, another as ARRIVED. Real Delivery.Status__c has no 'Returning' value yet.

_dataModelGraph.Delivery__c: D-00003147 (Vehicle__c->truck, Route__r=Demo Return Route 1, Driver__r=Jason Damaschun, Truck_Location__c->truck inventory Location, Status NOT IN {Complete,Cancelled})
_dataModelGraph.Inventory__c: one per Item on the truck location (Quantity_On_Hand__c > 0)
_dataModelGraph.Lot_Inventory__c: lot cargo; Lot__r.Is_Sellable__c drives Restockable vs Non-Restockable
_dataModelGraph.Item__c: Bluemoon / Twisted Tea Light / Corona Extra (Name, SKU_Number__c, Package_Type__c, Packaging_Type_Short_Name__c, Units_Per_Case__c)
